# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

NANAYEPE NTSHIAMIEME, WAMPUANGIDI ADIOYO DIAYEPE A DIA TSHINI. NANAYEPE A ITENIKUYI, BUOLO BUEME, BUKUOKOYO BUAWA, NTANA MUEME, A BUDUYI BUAWA. KUA NTSHIAMA YEKE A MUNA WENE, ANAMANA BAMUENGU, OLOKATUONO WENE MIETE.
